svg.title: Peripheral nerve
svg.desc: An idealised peripheral nerve in oblique section contains several fascicles within the epineurium. Each fascicle is bounded by perineurium and contains illustrated myelinated fibres and endoneurial supporting tissue.
svg.text: Oblique section showing fascicles and their envelopes

text.tspan: Illustrative nerve section. Fascicle and fibre counts are arbitrary; unmyelinated fibres are omitted. Not a quantitative histological
Anatomical reference: OpenStax, Anatomy and Physiology 2e, section 13.4.
